# Visuals, Screens & Immersion

Goal (Jules, 2026-11-05): pleasant, immersive screens and a carefully chosen set of resource packs, data packs and shaders. Everything below is pinned in `pack/manifest.toml`. Screenshots in `docs/screenshots/` come from the real pack, rendered by the cloud client test (Mesa software rendering, no shaders), so colours on a real GPU will be richer.

## Our own resource pack: Homestead Resources (`resourcepacks/homestead-resources`, MIT, generated by `tools/gen_resources.py`)
| Screen | What changed |
|---|---|
| **Title screen** | A 360° **panorama of the pack's own world** (a village at morning), captured in-game with vanilla's panorama renderer through the dev harness. A "**Homestead Edition**" banner under the logo in original pixel lettering. **Homestead splash texts** ("Check the barometer!", "Glass counts as a roof!", "Hello, Jules!" …). |
| **Loading screen** | `darkMojangStudiosBackground:true` gives a calm dark loading screen instead of bright red. **RRLS** reloads resource packs in the background when you change them in game (`config/rrls.toml`: `hideOverlays = "RELOADING"`). The first load at start-up keeps the normal loading screen, so a world can't open before its textures are ready. |
| **Quest book** | A warm **walnut** theme with cream text and gold highlights. The *Weather Wise* chapter uses a frosty slate background; the *Power* and *Kitchen* chapters use a warm ember background (FTB Quests theme selectors on chapter tags). |
| **Jade tooltips** | The "Homestead (walnut)" theme (walnut box, gold frame) matches the quest book. It's set as the default in `config/jade/jade.json`. |
| **Item tooltips** | **Legendary Tooltips**: framed tooltips with item previews. |
| **Containers** | **Recolourful Containers** (vanilla+ mode): wooden crafting area, themed anvil, enchanting and so on. |
| **Inventory & containers in 3D** | **Spatial GUI**: the screen becomes a panel floating in the world beside your character, and the camera swings to third person. It works together with Recolourful Containers, which supplies the textures shown on the panel. See below. |

## Spatial GUI (Jules' pick, 2026-11-05)
[Spatial GUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/spatial-gui) 1.10.1, client-only, MIT licence. It needs YACL and Mod Menu, which the pack already has. It's a mod rather than a resource pack: it changes *where* screens are drawn, while Recolourful Containers changes *how they look*, so both are used.
* **Shipped with the mod's own defaults**, which is the look on its Modrinth page:
  * third-person view with your character turned towards the panel;
  * a soft drop shadow and an open/close animation.
* **3D screens:** the inventory, chests and every container (including the Electric Oven, backpacks and storage), plus books, lecterns, villager trading and JEI recipe pages.
* **Flat screens:** the quest book, menus, MCA dialogues and the pause screen. Screenshot `showcase-questbook.png` confirms the quest book stays flat.
* **Change it** in *Mod Menu → Spatial GUI*:
  * **View Mode → First Person** gives a panel in front of you instead of third person. **Disable in First Person** keeps normal screens while you play in first person.
  * **Enabled** off turns it off completely, back to flat screens.
  * **Blur World Background** is experimental.
  * Bind *Open Visual Editor* in *Controls* to drag the panel where you like it. You can also give different screens their own placement (the backtick key opens the profile picker).
* **Known quirks:**
  * JEI's item list and a few small mod buttons stay flat on screen around the panel; you can see this in the screenshots.
  * The author marks the mod as early development: if a modded screen misbehaves, add its class name to *Disabled Screens*. Its *Seen Screens* list shows the names.
* Screenshots: `showcase-inventory.png`, `showcase-crafting.png` (Recolourful's wooden crafting area on the panel), `showcase-range.png` (our Electric Oven).

## Resource packs (enabled by default, bottom → top)
A Good Place default animations (built into the mod) · Better Leaves · Fresh Animations + Details + Objects + Emissive (official extensions) · Fancy Crops (built for Farmer's Delight) · Simple Grass Flowers · Better Lanterns · Fresh Flower Pots · Clean Connected Glass (Continuity) · Animated Items · TheOne's Eating Animation · Even Better Enchants · Visual Armor Trims · Low On Fire · Fast Better Grass · Connected Paths · Fancy Beds · Fluffy Carpets · Ray's 3D Ladders · Just Expressions · Fresh Seeds · Better Flame Particles · Torches Reimagined · Renewed Bookshelf · Homestead GUI · Recolourful Containers · Dramatic Skys (via Nuit) · **Homestead Resources** (top).
Shipped but off: **Emissive Glowing Ores** (an accessibility option; replaced New Glowing Ores in 1.1, which 26.1 rejects as an old-format pack).
Deliberately not used: the Fresh Animations *player* extension (overlaps Not Enough Animations), CozyUI+ (its HD modern style clashes with 16× blocks), full texture overhauls (to keep the vanilla look).

## Menus (1.1)
**Homestead GUI** (resource pack by kindabland, public alpha) themes the menus in wood and stone:
* oak-plank buttons (lighter when highlighted, dark walnut when disabled);
* a dark stone hotbar;
* slate-and-gold toasts and advancement frames (item tooltips stay with Legendary Tooltips);
* the recipe book, statistics and world and server lists.

It sits **below Recolourful Containers**, which keeps drawing every container screen: Homestead GUI's own container
textures are unfinished (the inventory and chest are themed, the crafting table and furnace are still grey). The walnut
quest book, the Jade theme and the Electric Oven screen already use the matching wood palette.

## Smooth animations (1.1)
| What moves | Mod | Settings |
|---|---|---|
| Doors, gates, trapdoors, levers, buttons, lecterns, chests, cauldrons, composters; lanterns and chains sway | Fancy World Animations | `/fwaConfig` or Mod Menu |
| Items glide between inventory slots (also when sorting) | Smooth Swapping | Mod Menu |
| Scrolling in lists, chat, creative tabs and the hotbar | Smooth Scroll | Mod Menu |
| New chunks fade in instead of popping up | Chunks Fade In | Mod Menu |
| Placed blocks settle into place | A Good Place | switch off its built-in resource pack to disable |
| Dropped items lie flat and tumble | ItemPhysic Lite | its config file (`config/itemphysic*`) |
| The camera glides up stairs and slabs | Countered's Smooth Steps | Mod Menu |
| Mobs and objects (Fresh Animations), first-person animations in third person (Not Enough Animations), eating, falling leaves, wakes | already in 1.0 | — |

## Immersive nights (1.1)
* **Without shaders:** Dramatic Skys' night sky and stars; lanterns and chains sway (FWA); fireflies over grass and
  water (Particular); torches and lanterns light up around you when held (LambDynamicLights); mob eyes and glowing parts
  shine in the dark (Fresh Animations Emissive); hostile mobs dig out of the ground or appear in a puff of smoke (Spawn
  Animations); night-time ambience such as crickets and owls (AmbientSounds).
* **With shaders**, the pack seeds night settings the first time you pick a shader (your own shader settings are never
  overwritten, because YOSBR only copies a file that doesn't exist yet):
  * *Complementary Reimagined*: northern lights on full-moon nights or in snowy biomes, galaxy nebulae, and moon-phase
    lighting (a new moon is the darkest night).
  * *Photon*: occasional northern lights anywhere, often in snowy biomes, and the Milky Way. Its night lighting already
    follows the moon phase.
* Not added on purpose: "true darkness" mods. They are built for horror and lock the brightness slider.

## Data packs (installed as Fabric mods so they apply to every world)
Structory + Structory Towers (atmospheric ruins and towers by Terralith's authors) · Explorify (vanilla-friendly small structures) · Gardener's Dream (any plant in pots) · Remove Terralith Intro Message (no chat spam on join) · Snow Under Trees (winter snow under canopies; supports Serene Seasons).
Considered and not used: Dungeons & Taverns (custom-enchantment dungeons lean RPG), Incendium (combat-focused Nether), Geophilic (overlaps Terralith), From the Fog (horror).

## Immersion mods
Subtle Effects (sparks, smoke, snoring Z's, dust; each effect toggleable; replaces Visuality) · Ambient Environment (subtle biome colour variation) · Wakes (water wakes) · Camera Overhaul (**tuned down**: half roll and sway, off in third person) · Overflowing Bars (compact heart and armour rows; thermoo-patches supports it) · already present: AmbientSounds, Sound Physics, Presence Footsteps, Falling Leaves, Particle Rain, First-person Model, 3D Skin Layers, Not Enough Animations, LambDynamicLights.

## Shaders (optional; pick in *Video Settings → Shader Packs*)
| Pack | Look | Hardware |
|---|---|---|
| Complementary Reimagined | Faithful to vanilla, cinematic | mid–high |
| Photon | Semi-realistic, gorgeous light | high |
| Mellow | Painterly, soft, cozy | low–mid |
| MakeUp Ultra Fast | Light and clean | low |
Shaders draw their own sky (Dramatic Skys then has no effect) and may override blizzard fog.

## Verified in the cloud client (software GL)
* All packs and mods load together (260 mods including libraries); every resource pack is active.
* Screenshots: `showcase-questbook.png` (walnut theme), `showcase-jade.png` (walnut Jade tooltip), `showcase-inventory.png`, `showcase-crafting.png`, `showcase-range.png` (Spatial GUI panels; the IPN auto-refill icons are gone), `showcase-village.png`, `client-smoke-blizzard.png` (blizzard fog and snow), `title-screen.png`.
* Cosmetic: EMF logs that it ignores a few block-entity models (chest, bed, banner), so Fresh Animations Objects won't animate those.

Overall look and colours, Dramatic Skys skies, shaders, comfort of Camera Overhaul, readability of the walnut quest book at your GUI scale, and how Spatial GUI feels in everyday play (mouse tracking on the panel, shaders behind it).
